title: RANK window — ties share rank (Sql)
description: RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pts DESC) numbers rows by score with gaps after ties: two first places, then third. DENSE_RANK skips the gap; ROW_NUMBER never ties.
code:
SELECT name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pts DESC) AS r
FROM s ORDER BY r, name;
how_it_works: The window sorts by points; equal values receive the same rank and the next rank skips ahead.

test_cases.note: Determinism check: re-running the snippet reproduces the identical output.

pitfalls: Use the right function: leaderboards usually want RANK or DENSE_RANK, not ROW_NUMBER. Reproduce it once on purpose in a scratch file: seeing the failure teaches the fix faster than reading about it.
